item.title: Kansas Legislature approves 'Charlie Kirk Free Speech Day'
item.description: After an 87-35 vote on the House floor on Tuesday morning, a day in October will now officially be recognized as "Charlie Kirk Free Speech Day" by the Kansas Legislature.

item.title: Murder charges dropped against 1 of 2 suspects in Lawrence bar shooting
item.description: One of two suspects charged in a shooting at a popular Lawrence, Kansas, bar last month no longer faces murder charges.

item.title: Kansas in-state tuition policies for non-citizens violate federal law: Kobach
item.description: Kansas Attorney General Kris Kobach has issued a new legal opinion Tuesday stating that a section of state law that grants in-state tuition to non-citizens is in violation of federal law.
